comment: Level 4. Read by BOTH the game (controlquest/gameplay/level_data.py) and the engine (engine_server/level_rules/common.py). Calibrated with engine_server/calibrate.py.

knobs.name: margin
knobs.label: Obstacle margin
knobs.help: Added to every semi-axis of the obstacle ellipses [m]: a safety buffer for what the model gets wrong.

knobs.name: g
knobs.label: Model actuator gain
knobs.help: How strongly the controller's model thinks the ball responds to a command: x+ = f(x, u; g). 1 = exactly as commanded.
